description: This file contains functions and rules for normalizing and migrating legacy Telegram channel configuration settings within a larger OpenClaw project. It includes type imports, utility functions for handling configuration objects, rules for detecting legacy settings, and a main function to normalize the configuration.

methods.name: asObjectRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> if it is an object and not an array; otherwise returns null.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramStreamingAliases
methods.description: Normalizes the streaming alias configuration, resolving legacy modes and updating the configuration object accordingly.

methods.name: hasLegacyTelegramStreamingAliases
methods.description: Checks if a given configuration object contains legacy Telegram streaming alias settings.

methods.name: hasLegacyTelegramAccountStreamingAliases
methods.description: Checks if any account within a set of Telegram accounts has legacy streaming alias settings.

methods.name: resolveCompatibleDefaultGroupEntry
methods.description: Resolves the default group entry within a section, ensuring proper object shape for migration.

methods.name: normalizeCompatibilityConfig
methods.description: Main function that normalizes the entire Telegram configuration within an OpenClawConfig object, applying legacy migrations and returning the updated config and change log.
